KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.

2. When practising Maagano, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Maagano.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Maagano.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Maagano.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Maagano.

3. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   B. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   C. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.

4. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.

5. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.

6. When practising Usalama, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Usalama.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Usalama.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Usalama.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Usalama.

7. When practising upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   C. Copy random text without understanding upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   D. Use insults to “practise” upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.

8. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. mitoto
   B. mato
   C. watoto
   D. kitoto

9. When practising nyakati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to nyakati.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for nyakati.
   C. Copy random text without understanding nyakati.
   D. Use insults to “practise” nyakati.

10. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. nene
   B. zito
   C. pana
   D. fupi

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain nyakati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Usalama and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Maagano and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
